name: shrink-container
description: Standalone Node service that runs inside the Cloudflare Container: pulls a raw GLB from R2 (S3), runs the RUN APPAREL asset pipeline (optimize --simplify + validate), and returns the shrunk GLB with a report. NOT a workspace member — built only inside Docker (see ../Dockerfile). The asset-pipeline deps are installed alongside its source in the image; only this service's own deps live here.
